275106303.description:
Wahl Signature
Gold Filled Ring Top Fountain Pen
Early 20th Century
This vintage Wahl Signature fountain pen features a gold-filled case with a classic chased geometric pattern. Produced during the golden age of American writing instruments, this "ring top" model was designed for portability, intended to be worn on a watch chain or chatelaine. The nib is clearly marked "Wahl Signature Pen 14K," identifying the high-quality gold content characteristic of these premium writing tools. The barrel is personalized with the engraved name "E. BURKLE."
Wahl Signature 14K gold nib (tested and marked)
Vintage gold filled case with decorative chased design
Ring top attachment for chain or lanyard use
Lever-filler mechanism for ink loading
Approximately 3.75 inches in length
Condition:
Vintage condition with visible signs of age and use. The gold-filled surface shows a natural aged patina and minor surface scratches; no significant dents or plating loss observed on the exterior. The personalized engraving "E. BURKLE" is deep and legible. The internal section shows significant ink residue and oxidation at the threads and section joint. The nib shows surface wear and staining but remains structurally intact. The filling mechanism has not been restored; functionality of the internal ink sac is unknown and should be assumed to require service for writing use.
Warehouse Location: Canton
